title: The Specification Paradox: Rethinking Requirements Engineering in the Age of AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.16618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Software Engineering has reinforced the expectation that coding activities can be largely automated. However, this perception may represent yet another historical search for a solution capable of eliminating the inherent challenges of software development. This article discusses the transition from a code-centered paradigm to Specification-Driven Development. We argue that artificial intelligence reduces some of the effort associated with writing source code, but it does not eliminate the complexity of developing professional software systems. Instead, it shifts this complexity toward domain understanding, requirements elicitation, specification development, validation, maintenance, and software evolution. translated_title: 规格悖论：在人工智能时代重新思考需求工程
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中的日益普及，强化了编码活动可以大规模自动化的预期。然而，这种看法可能只是历史上又一次寻找能消除软件开发固有挑战的解决方案的尝试。本文讨论了从以代码为中心的范式向规格驱动开发的转变。我们认为，人工智能减少了编写源代码的部分工作量，但它并未消除开发专业软件系统的复杂性。相反，它将这种复杂性转移到了领域理解、需求获取、规格开发、验证、维护和软件演化上。基于这一视角，我们讨论了需求工程重新获得的核心地位，考虑了其对生产力和软件质量的影响以及相关风险。
tldr: 本文提出“规格悖论”，认为AI虽自动化了编码，但将软件开发复杂性转向需求工程，强调规格驱动开发成为新核心。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "Specification Paradox," arguing that while AI automates coding, it shifts software development complexity to requirements engineering, making specification-driven development the new core.
